job.title: Modern Workplace Support Engineer - Audio Visual
job.description:
The Company:

A boutique AV integration business with business hubs in both Sydney and Brisbane are looking to bring a technically minded Modern Workplace Support Engineer into the business. The business specializes in delivering MS Teams and Zoom meeting rooms for corporate and government clients.

The role:

This is a hands-on role for someone that can solve complex technical AV issues and support end users of the business.
You will provide onsite and remote support for workplace technology solutions (Google meet, MS Teams etc.) whilst integrating with the companies' AV environments.
High levels of stakeholder management are needed as you will be onsite representing the company and dealing with all levels of seniority

You will need experience with:
  • Supporting corporate AV, unified comms and workplace technology 
  • Hands on support with meeting rooms - remotely & onsite
  • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve faults across audio, video, control and network connected AV systems 
  • Strong communication and stake holder management skills 
  • Must have experience with vendor technology Crestron , Logitech, Neat, Yealink
What is on offer:
  • $100,000-$120,000+Super+Company Vehicle
  • Join a growing and already well-established business, job security is a given 
  • Exposure to leading corporate and government customers 
  • Work with state of the art cutting edge technology and a team of highly skilled individuals

job.title: Account Executive AV
job.description:
The Company:
  
A boutique AV integration business with business hubs in both Sydney and Brisbane are looking to bring a technically minded Account Executive into the business.  The business specializes in delivering MS Teams and Zoom meeting rooms for corporate and government clients.
  
The Role:
  
The position is focused on converting warm incoming leads into sales and helping walk clients through the technical side of the integration.  You will not be doing any new business as currently there are more leads coming in than the ability to service them.
  
Ideally, you will have some technical knowledge in the AV space so you can talk credibly about the integration and AV/VC environments.
  
Requirements for the role:
  
  • 2+ years working in either a technical support of sales focused role with the AV industry 
  •  Strong consultative sales ability, not looking for a hardnosed new business person but someone that can build strong relationships and convert incoming warm leads 
  • Knowledge of meeting room packages (Yealink, Logitech, Crestron) 
  • Ability to draw up requirements and run the sales process from end to end 
  
What's on offer:
  
  • Huge upside with the commission, ability to double your base salary over the years with uncapped comms
  • Work remotely - only need to visit client site and office when needed no requirements for a regular / weekly office visit 
  • Work with some technical experts and build on their knowledge base

job.title: Junior to Mid level - Audio Visual Installer
job.description:

The Role:
This position is for a Junior to Mid levelled Audio-Visual Technician to be responsible for the full installation process onsite with clients. You will be working solely within the corporate sector, and you will be able to choose which locations suit you better and concentrate on those clients.
Working on a range of different projects on a weekly basis looking at full video conferencing fit outs installation of cutting-edge AV solutions.
  
Key Criteria Needed:
  • Over 2+ years of experience working within the AV industry within the integration side of the market
  • Ability to conduct on-site AV installations and day-to-day workflow
  • Proven experience with systems and equipment such as Crestron, QSYS
  • Communicate clearly with clients and keep them informed of progress
  
Benefits
  • Huge progression internally
  • Great average tenure across business
  • Lean heavily on IT market
  • Government & Education projects
Great opportunity to work for a progressive and well recognized AV solutions integrator and be part of their ongoing success in the industry

job.title: Customer Success Manager - Workplace Technology

job.title: Audio Visual Manager
job.description:
The Company:

Large multi disciplined communications provider with offices across every state in Australia and a history spanning back over 50 years are looking to make a key hire within their NSW team.

The company works with a large range of government departments and agencies, providing audio visual solutions across local, state and federal government, alongside high end commercial and corporate clients.

The Role:

A Senior AV Installation Team Lead required to work across multiple projects, mainly corporate, education, and government bodies alongside a team of technicians / installers. You will be responsible for installations of video conferencing, visual displays, custom LED video walls and modern workplace collaboration spaces.

You will manage and mentor junior staff and be responsible for full projects of installation alongside Project Managers to ensure work is delivered in line with expectations.

Requirements:

  • Experience in Video Conferencing, Audio Visual and Control systems such as AMX, Creston, Extron, Cisco and Poly.
  • Experience in Audio Visual installations and technical experience (Electrical, cabling, Telco, or IT installations also considered)
  • Field quality control, cable rough ins and service fit outs all fall under your responsibilities
  • You will be client facing, representing the business to complete full installations across a range of industries
  • Experience with a range of hand tools / Electrical license would be ideal  
Company benefits

  • Top Rates $$$$
  • Genuine career path to senior management or director level 
  • 9 day fortnight (RDO's)
  • Overtime
  • Car allowance

job.title: Audio Visual Programmer
job.description:
The Company:
  
The business has been established for almost 30 years and are a well known name in the Audio-Visual integration space in Victoria.

The Integration Division specializes in creating seamless environments where audio, video, lighting, and automation work together.

From performing arts centers and education campuses to government facilities and modern commercial spaces, we work with world-leading technologies including Extron, Crestron, Dante, DMX, and AV over IP
  
The Role:
  
We are looking to recruit an AV Programmer / Commissioner lead the development and deployment of intelligent control systems using Q-SYS and Crestron mainly but will involve other technologies.
  
You will need:
  
  • Advanced Crestron and Extron programming skills
  • Ability to commission MS Teams rooms
  • Experience with Crestron Flex, Yealink and Logitech conference solutions
  • AV schematics and build control flow
  • Proven experience programming and deploying Q-SYS control environments
  
What's in it for you;
  
  • Work with a team of experienced experts and build a solid all round knowledge base. The team deliver what is promised and all help to make each other succeed
  • Opportunity to move up quicky within the business and look at more management and director level roles
  • Strong salary and car allowance, regular reviews and chance to earn more quickly
